title: Nice night lamp but not clock
text: Nice night lamp but not clock. We ordered this for our bedroom. By looking at images we thought it is big, but it is very small. Lighting is really good and you can change multiple colors, intensity as well.  Clock option is not good, I could not find a way to show the clock always, it is very disappointing. Charging works fine. Bluetooth is nice feature to transmit songs from your person device to this speaker.  In overall it is okay, but not great with all features..
